subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Henry is so __servile__ that other people take advantage of him.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Arrogant.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• "**Servile**" means excessively willing to please or obey others.

 
 
• Example: He bowed his head in a servile manner.
 
 
 
• "**Arrogant**" means having an exaggerated sense of one's own importance or abilities.
 
 
• Example: He is a very arrogant and rude person.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that "arrogant" is the opposite of "servile."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• In option 2, **Sheepish** means showing embarrassment or shame.
 
• In option 3, **Bickering** means engaging in petty, often prolonged, arguments or quarrels.
 
• In option 4, **Cunning** means having or showing skill in achieving one's ends by deceit or evasion.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

__
 
• **"Servile" **का मतलब होता है दूसरों की खुशी या आज्ञा का अत्यन्त पालन करने के लिए तत्पर होना। 
 
• **"Arrogant"** का अर्थ होता है अपनी महत्वभूता या योग्यताओं का अत्यधिक आकलन करने वाला। 
 
• **"Sheepish" **का अर्थ है शर्म या संकोच दिखाना। ("Sheepish" means showing embarrassment or shame.)
 
• **"Bickering"** इस शब्द का अर्थ है छोटी-छोटी बातों पर झगड़ना या विवाद करना। ("Bickering" means arguing or quarreling about petty matters.)
 
• **"Cunning" **का मतलब होता है कपट या धोखे से अपने उद्देश्य को प्राप्त करने में कुशलता दिखाना। ("Cunning" means having or showing skill in achieving one's ends by deceit or evasion.)
